model: One fixed-priority preemptive processor; one higher-priority sporadic interrupt; bounded nonpreemptive blocking. Integer microseconds; no self-suspension, release overhead beyond stated WCET, multicore interference or DMA contention.
observation_limits: The stated execution and blocking bounds are synthetic inputs, not measured WCET.
The recurrence is a sufficient fixed-priority response bound only under its stated task/release model; passing it is not a schedulability proof for an arbitrary firmware image.
An actual target requires measured clock, compiler/map provenance, trace losses, instrumentation overhead and a justified WCET upper bound; finite observed maxima alone are not that bound.
